reportedIssues: The delivery address line reads "Weizenergi 20, Tallinn", which appears to be a misspelling or concatenation of the street name and house number ("Weizen" + street number "20").
The pizza card in the "Popular right now" section shows a "-0%" discount badge, which is a nonsensical value and renders as an odd empty discount.
The heart (favorite) icons on the restaurant cards are icon-only buttons without visible labels or accessible names.
The notification bell icon in the top-right is an icon-only control with no visible text label.
The green primary action button ("Order now") inside the promotional banner uses white text on green, and the banner's secondary line of text (light text on green) appears low-contrast.
